describes: A Firebase Hosting preview channel named for HEAD. A person deploys the channel (it uploads a build, so it is theirs to run); the engine reads the channel's URL back and runs the e2e suite against it.
verify: After deploying the channel by hand, run the wait command once from the repo root: it must print the channel's https URL and exit 0, and print nothing for a commit with no channel. The JSON shape (result.channels[].name and .url) is written from memory of `firebase hosting:channel:list --json`; check it first. Then set "verified": true here, with the date and CLI version in "verifiedAgainst".
needs: the firebase CLI, logged in (or a CI token in the environment), with the project selected (.firebaserc)
a build step before the deploy if the hosting directory is generated
the e2e suite reading its base URL from $BASE_URL

recipe.name: e2e against the Firebase preview channel for HEAD

steps.note: uploads the current build to a preview channel named for this commit
prints the channel URL once the channel exists
